scope: Planning appendix only. No assets or gameplay code produced.

priority_legend.P1: First integrated visual slice after reference approval
priority_legend.P2: Complete current successor presentation and required solo/frontend flow; not a claim all runtime features exist
priority_legend.P3: Future-only, gated by gameplay or frontend implementation

counting: Each non-screen record is one logical master/family. Its states, sizes, instances, frames and technical-map channels are not separate master counts. Screen rows are composition tasks and must not be commissioned as flattened UI images. Hero portraits, ability icons, traits and relic illustrations belong to the separate character/content inventory.

asset_schema_notes.source_id: Canonical stable hero/cost/star ID when applicable; null for shared UI.
asset_schema_notes.dependency: Reference IDs, inventory asset IDs or explicitly prefixed external content dependencies.
asset_schema_notes.master_size: Proposed source dimensions; vector source remains resolution independent.
asset_schema_notes.runtime_sizes: Proposed import/use sizes or responsive behavior, not measured acceptance.
asset_schema_notes.states: Required coverage and/or layered variants, not a command to generate one image per state.
asset_schema_notes.frame_proposal: Optional illustrative flipbook proposal; actual release/duration/expiry bound to authoritative state/events.
